task_instance: Generate a custom theme (color palette + font pairing) for a fintech startup pitch deck described as 'trustworthy but innovative', then apply that theme's colors/fonts consistently to a 3-slide HTML pitch deck artifact (NimbusPay), per the skill's 'Create your Own Theme' + 'Application Process' steps.
evidence: Created work/deck.html (an unstyled 3-slide HTML deck for a fictional startup 'NimbusPay') and work/theme-fintech-pulse.json (a generated custom theme spec: 'Fintech Pulse' - color palette with hex codes for primary/secondary/accent/background/surface/text, and a heading/body font pairing 'Space Grotesk'/'Inter' with a Google Fonts import URL). Applied the theme to deck.html via CSS custom properties (--color-primary, --font-heading, etc.) used consistently across body, headings, slide backgrounds, and list markers. Verified programmatically with a Python script that: (1) every theme color hex value appears in the deck's CSS, (2) both font families are referenced, (3) the Google Fonts import is present, (4) all 3 slides exist, and (5) text/background color pairs meet WCAG AA contrast ratios (16.51:1 for body text on surface, 9.35:1 for headings on surface, both well above the 4.5:1 / 3:1 minimums). All checks passed. Note: the skill's own bundled assets (theme-showcase.pdf and the themes/ directory with the 10 pre-set themes) were not present in the skill source directory (only SKILL.md and LICENSE existed), so the pre-set-theme-selection path could not be exercised as-is; instead the 'Create your Own Theme' path (explicitly part of the skill, requiring no bundled assets) was used as the representative task, and it fully succeeded end-to-end with no missing runtime capability.
